nodes.notes: Daily. Scores yesterday's signals once their 24h window has closed.

nodes.notes: Reads all rows. Verify the operation shows as "Read Rows" after import.

nodes.name: Select pending
nodes.notes: Keeps only directional rows with no outcome whose 24h window has closed. Empty -> run ends, no API call.

nodes.name: Fetch 15min
nodes.notes: One call per run. Same Twelve Data query-auth credential as the main workflow.

nodes.name: Classify
nodes.notes: Walks each row's 24h window: target / stop / none / no_data / ambiguous. Same logic as the backtest.

nodes.notes: Update Row, matching on ts_utc. Verify the operation + matching column after import.
